en.basel-kadem: 103.	We were told by Ali bin Ahmad bin Musa, may Allah be pleased with him, that he said: We were told by Muhammed bin Abi Abdillah al-Kufi, from Musa bin Imran al-Nakha’i, from his paternal uncle, Hussain bin Yazid al-Nawfali, from Ali bin Abi Hamza, from Abu Baseer, that he said:

I asked him about what was narrated from the Prophet, Allah’s blessings be upon him and his Family, that he said: «Indeed, the begotten from fornication was the worst of the three» What is the meaning of it? He said: By that, he indicated the middle one, that he is worse than the one who preceded him and the one who succeeded him.
